summary: @SaraJPeden No can not think of one comprehension researcher advocating for a single factor model, and I know most if not all of them. Would love to learn more if those do exist. That said folks saying SVR rah rah.... Way better predictive models.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @SaraJPeden No can not think of one comprehension researcher advocating for a single factor model, and I know most if not all of them. Would love to learn more if those do exist. That said folks saying SVR rah rah.... Way better predictive models.
